scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run generate -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.local-dev:init: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const d=path.join('local-dev');if(fs.existsSync(d))console.log('local-dev/ already exists');else{fs.cpSync('local-dev.example',d,{recursive:true});console.log('Created local-dev/ — run npm run wipe:kranti etc.');}"
